out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Licensed midwives and out-of-hospital providers order newborn screening collection cards through the Tennessee Department of Health. Supplies are requested via the TDH Newborn Screening supply ordering process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24-48 hours of age; repeat screen required if first collected before 24 hours or if specified by the lab.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the ordering provider; parents receive results from their provider. Tracking via the TDH Newborn Screening portal.

metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Tennessee provides an official state refusal form, PH-3686. Under Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 1200-15-01-.01, newborn screening is required and may be refused only on religious grounds; the signed PH-3686 is filed with the provider and TDH. A separate 'Newborn Eye Treatment Refusal' form is also issued by TDH for the eye prophylaxis refusal.

hearing_screening.program_name: Tennessee Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife performs or arranges the newborn hearing screen and documents results; refusal is documented on the screening paperwork / medical record per T.C.A. 68-5-201.
hearing_screening.statute: T.C.A. ÃÂÃÂ§ 68-5-201 et seq. (includes hearing screening); TN EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented per T.C.A. 68-5-201.
cchd_screening.statute: T.C.A. ÃÂÃÂ§ 68-5-201 et seq. (critical congenital heart defect screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: Prophylactic eye treatment is mandatory, but TDH policy (Public Chapter 989 / T.C.A. ÃÂÃÂ§ 68-5-502) permits a parent to refuse on religious grounds by filing a written statement with the Department of Health. TDH issues a specific 'Newborn Eye Treatment Refusal' form for this purpose.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: 0.5% erythromycin applied to each eye within one hour of birth. Refusal form: https://www.tn.gov/content/dam/tn/health/program-areas/newborn-screening/TDH_policy_announcement_re_newborn_eye_treatment_refusal.pdf

vitamin_k.note: Tennessee does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to TennIIS by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Tennessee provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
